description:
📌 Free template & guide: https://www.novitckii.com/resources/carousel-system/

In this video, I'm showing you exactly how to use ChatGPT to make Instagram carousels that look like a designer made them.

Instead of one-shotting your carousel and getting a generic AI-looking slop, you'll build slide 1 as a "visual anchor" and force every other slide to match. I used this exact system to make a carousel that hit nearly 100,000 views, and today I'm giving you the prompts, the copywriter skill, and the carousel bible PDF so you can do the same.

Don't worry, you don't need design skills or coding to build this.
